scenario: Triples in provably-empty cells per LCMP.2.2.2 are noted in the report. The compiler analyses the rule-schema-action interaction matrix; this test pins that a rule with a where predicate that makes some cells empty still compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Item scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    kind: String mutable
    qty: Int mutable

rule process_widgets:
    Item i where i.kind == "widget" and i.qty > 0
->
    log info "widget count positive"
